_comment: Measured, not chosen. Regenerate by running the suite with
and reading the numbers out of it. Raised when coverage improves; lowered
only in a change that explains why the drop is correct.
measured_revision: working tree after the audit fixes, with worker QThreads traced (tests/conftest.py); 3796 tests

qicom/io/nifti_anonymize.py.why: de-identification is fail-closed; a missed branch is a header that was not stripped. Every branch is covered, so anything less is a regression

qicom/metrics/learned_weights.py.why: the only network access in the application, gated on consent and a pinned SHA-256

qicom/session/recent_projects.py.why: writes into the user profile and must degrade rather than fail an open project. Every branch is covered, so anything less is a regression

qicom/reporting/excel_safety.py.why: formula-injection escaping; a missed branch is a cell that reaches a spreadsheet live

qicom/session/archive_safety.py.why: every untrusted archive enters here - traversal, symlinks, budgets, free space, and the cleanup that follows a refusal

qicom/io/dicom_anonymize.py.why: fail-closed DICOM de-identification. Target raised toward 90 as the remaining malformed-dataset paths gain tests

qicom/reporting/llm_export.py.why: the export that leaves the machine: a whitelist, a row budget and an atomic write

qicom/build_identity.py.why: identifies the source behind a result. The frozen and git-absent branches are mocked rather than exercised, so the reachable ceiling here is low

qicom/radiomics/ibsi_validation.py.why: the second network access: official IBSI resources downloaded on request, verified by SHA-256 and size, then parsed (a workbook and NIfTI images from the network). Target set at the measured level and raised as tests land

qicom/io/bitmap_anonymize.py.why: PNG chunk and JPEG segment surgery that removes embedded text, EXIF and XMP from exported bitmaps; a damaged structure must be refused, never guessed.

qicom/io/deidentification.py.why: Carries every image that could not be de-identified from the format modules to the user's decision; a refusal lost on the way would export identifying data unannounced.

qicom/atomic_files.py.why: Every persistent write goes through it: an unpredictable temporary, fsync and an atomic rename, so a failure or a second writer never leaves a corrupt file in place.

qicom/io/dicom_edit.py.why: writes edited copies of patient files: never over a source, all or nothing, pixel-defining tags locked, no old value in the log; a missed branch is an edit reaching a file it should not

qicom/io/output_folders.py.why: every multi-file tool output is staged and renamed into an empty, real destination here; a missed branch is a half-written folder or one written over existing files

qicom/io/folder_deidentification.py.why: the anonymizer's path into the fail-closed de-identifiers; a missed branch is a file written without its de-identification or a refusal that writes

qicom/io/file_listing.py.why: tool folder walks never follow a link out of the chosen folder

qicom/segmentation/label_files.py.why: reads label tables that can come from anywhere: bounded size, exact version, validated labels, a map whose values are all defined
